summary: Iteration 3 (multi-select campaign types + CPL direct input + targeted lead-counts) verified end-to-end. Backend 15/15 pytest passed. Frontend Playwright E2E confirmed textarea job titles, multi-select chips, CPL-only inputs, targeted-only lead computation, and full save→reload roundtrip.
critical_code_review_comments: CampaignTypeConfig still keeps legacy num_qq/num_cq/num_touches even though 'MQL with QQ'/'MQL with CQ' campaign type items already imply them; consider a single source of truth to avoid inconsistency.
LEAD_MULTIPLIERS and lead_multipliers key are still exposed in /api/reference but no longer used anywhere (CPL is now direct user input). Consider removing to reduce API surface confusion.

compute_section3 sets lead_counts=0 for non-targeted rows but still preserves the user-entered cpl on the row - fine UX, but confirm CSV/XLSX consumers understand that non-zero CPL with zero leads is intentional.
seed_data_creation: TEST_UI_ITER3 RFP created and deleted during Playwright test; no residual data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend uses env var REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL; must be exported in shell when running pytest directly. Iter3 breaking changes verified: campaign_type_config.types (List[str]) replaces .type (str), LeadRow schema is {lead_type, cpl, lead_counts, total_cost} — no cpc. Only lead-types in campaign_to_lead_types(section1.campaign_type_config) receive non-zero lead_counts. MultiSelect stays open between clicks (does not auto-close); click outside to close. Edit is triggered via first button icon in All RFPs row (not by clicking text).
